# FTB test fixtures

Recorded from the public FTB API (no key) on 2026-11-19 with the commands in the spec 035 T002 brief:
`search.json` (search term "stone"), `pack-<id>.json` (pack detail, `description` removed), `version-<id>-<versionId>.json` (version detail; `files` trimmed to the first 3 entries and `changelog` removed). Fields are otherwise untouched. Ids: 130 FTB StoneBlock 4 (NeoForge 1.21.1), 100 FTB StoneBlock 3 (Forge 1.18.2), 4 FTB Presents Stoneblock 2 (Forge 1.12.2).
